---
title: "Seasons"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(ggridges)
```

```{r}
mallards <- read_rds("data/mallards.rds")
```

```{r}
# Count GPS fixes for each month in calendar order (print all 12 months)
mallards |>
  count(month) |>
  print(n = 12)
```

```{r}
# Summarize speed distribution and count missing values
mallards |>
  summarize(
    min = min(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    q25 = quantile(speed, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean = mean(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    q75 = quantile(speed, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(speed, na.rm = TRUE),
    na_count = sum(is.na(speed))
  )
```

```{r}
#| message: false
# Drop speeds above 30 m/s (and NAs) and plot monthly ridges top-to-bottom
mallards |>
  filter(speed <= 30) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = speed, y = fct_rev(month), fill = season)) +
  geom_density_ridges(alpha = 0.8) +
  labs(
    title = "Mallard Movement Speeds by Month",
    x = "Speed (m/s)",
    y = "Month",
    fill = "Season"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
